snippet.title: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel | Release Date Reveal Trailer | PC & Consoles
snippet.description:
JOTUNNSLAYER: HORDES OF HEL LAUNCHES SEPTEMBER 3 ON PC & CONSOLES! 

The gates of Helheim are opening… and it’s the biggest update yet.

New Endless Mode - How long can you survive the Norse underworld?
New Class: Kinslayer - A fallen Valkyrie with a score to settle
New Deity: Nidhogg - From the depths below Yggdrasil
New Map: Helheim - A stunning, deadly new battlefield

Mark your calendar. Sharpen your axe. September 3.

ENTER THE HEL NOW:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2820820/Jotunnslayer_Hordes_of_Hel/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/jotunnslayer-hordes-of-hel-3579b3
